scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs sh -c "npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@kuber/client"
scripts.qa:code-coverage: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs sh -c "npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@kuber/client && node scripts/check-code-coverage.mjs"
scripts.qa:code-coverage:release: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs sh -c "npm run test:coverage --workspace=server && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@kuber/client && node scripts/check-code-coverage.mjs --release"
scripts.qa:gate: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs sh -c "npm run qa:code-coverage && npm run qa:feature-coverage"
scripts.qa:release-gate: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs sh -c "npm run qa:code-coverage:release && npm run qa:feature-coverage:release"
